title: SpaceAppClaimedPayload
description: space.app.claimed v1 (OpenVibe.Space, subject space spc_…, visibility internal): a guest draft (a space with no owner, edited with a secret link) was claimed by a signed-in person. The draft is that person's space now and its secret is gone. No secret, no file contents.

slug.description: the address it now has (one DNS label; the space is served at <slug>.openvibe.website once it is published)

template.description: the template it started from, when it started from one
